flagged.title: Stave 1: Scrooge & Marley's Ghost
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly teaches that the novella opens with 'Old Marley was as dead as a doornail' instead of 'Marley was dead: to begin with', which directly causes students to get Knowledge Check 1 wrong and misidentify the opening quotation in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: Instead, he drops us right into what feels like a witty, almost conversational chat... He just boldly declares: 'Old Marley was as dead as a doornail.'

flagged.title: Key Themes & Exam Technique
flagged.reason: The video states that the extract task assesses both AO1 and AO2 and instructs students to embed context to hit multiple assessment objectives, when Edexcel assesses AO2 alone on the extract, AO1 alone on the wider text, and does not assess context (AO3) on this section at all.

mark_affecting.quote: They're testing your textual references, those are your AO1 marks, and your analysis of language, form and structure, your AO2 marks.
Step 4 is honestly where a lot of students stumble. You have to embed context naturally... you're hitting multiple assessment objectives simultaneously.
